subject: Nariway — needs you: Leslie Anderson bridge questions
html:
Nariway — Needs You

Leslie Anderson’s window is closing.

Leslie Anderson (Bruce A. Beal Executive Director, Rollins Museum of Art) is still drafting her answers to the Conversation questions sent 2026-08-20. The two bridge questions the CFO steward asked to add before her draft closes have not gone out, flagged three days running (8/20, 8/21, 8/22) with no movement — the last day this is recoverable.

Why now: Matthew Erskine’s equivalent window already closed unrecovered. Leslie is the only remaining live conversation that can carry this — the one mechanism in the whole pipeline that points toward “can you help us with this?” instead of just a well-sourced quote.

The exact action: send Leslie (via PR contact Jo Marie Hebeler) one short follow-up with two questions —

“In your practice, how often does a family reach the point of deciding what happens to a significant collection — is this a recurring situation or a rare one?”

“Is there a family you’re working with now where this is live?”

— Toi
